abstract: The tissue cis-diamminedichloroplatinum (II) (CDDP) concentration was measured in autopsies treated with CDDP therapy for gynecological malignancies. These cases consisted of 10 of ovarian tumor and one of choriocarcinoma. Total CDDP doses administered were from 55mg to 560mg and among them three cases were treated with more than 500mg (525mg, 555mg in ovarian cancer and 560mg in choriocarcinoma). We found moderate renal impairment with this drug by serum functional test and histopathology, although these changes did not correspond with the total doses. In liver, kidney and residual tumor measured for CDDP, the tissue concentration was highest in liver. When total doses administered were compared with the tissue concentration in liver, kidney, residual tumor and the decrease in creatinine clearance value, there were statistically significant differences only in residual tumor at p less than 0.01.
abstract_ja: 婦人科悪性腫瘍に対するシスプラチン(CDDP)療法を受けた剖検例で、組織内CDDP濃度を測定した。対象は卵巣腫瘍10例と絨毛癌1例であった。総投与量は55mgから560mgであり、そのうち3例は500mg以上(卵巣癌では525mgと555mg、絨毛癌では560mg)を投与された。血清機能検査と病理組織学的検討により中等度の腎障害が認められたが、この変化は総投与量とは対応しなかった。測定対象の肝臓、腎臓、残存腫瘍のうち、組織内濃度は肝臓で最も高かった。総投与量と、肝臓、腎臓、残存腫瘍の組織内濃度、およびクレアチニンクリアランス値の低下を比較したところ、統計学的に有意な差が認められたのは残存腫瘍のみであった(p<0.01)。
